description: The rbtv ignite front door (dual audience): inspect jobs/queue/status/logs/daemon/ticker/messages/executions/asks, kill, snooze, and the job registration verbs - all of them served over the gateway, none of them holding daemon behavior
The CLI's client seam: gateway address selection, token resolution from the machine entry or .rbtv/config/sender-token.env, and the typed usage errors the verbs raise
